rca:flags.text: 2 of 23 upcasts found in the profiler data do not match a profile in the official index.
Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (87384 scans, 77583 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.

Bottle salinity is taken from the cruise's discrete summary (the laboratory's Autosal and cast-log workbooks are not available for this cruise); replicates are averaged and the summary's flags are applied.
Niskin 12 (CTD-020 Niskin 12, ~40 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle +0.0109 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.007 PSU/m.

OOI annotation 209 (None; 2015-07-07 20:47:00 to 2016-07-17 00:00:00) covers 10500 of the samples used: Due to errors during vendor calibration, a calibration offset (CC_offset) of -1.7 is being applied during the on-demand creation of the L1 Seawater Pressure (dbar) data product from this instrument. For more information please contact help@oceanobservatories.org.
